essence: The ritual preparation requires inscribing the formula on birch bark, forming it into a pill, and encasing it in gold.
Possessing the talisman enables the practitioner to gain all sovereignties and subjugate the three worlds.
Divine weapons, including the brahma-weapon, become harmless when directed at the talisman's bearer.
The bearer of the talisman can swiftly cause death to others by a weapon strike.
Those who have attained all powers move freely within a radiance resembling dark cloud streams.
